items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-29
items.q: Yes, I worked with all of them, too. ... there was Terry Shan and Charlie Cordella and Red Bowman and, uh, Sidney Ayrton, and they sent for me, and I went over to join them in San Antonio. And we worked together for, oh, a year or so, I guess.

ctx.x: Would you call it, what they called goofus in those days, or would you call it, uh, like— We'd call it hot, hot trumpet. Hot trumpet, you'd call it. Yeah. Uh-huh. And that's what he was playing. Yeah. Um, did you ever know Charlie Cordella or Red Bowman or Sidney Ayrton?

Yes, I worked with all of them, too. Um, well, they were over in San Antonio. Worked in a little, uh, road spot, tavern, and, uh, there was Terry Shan and Charlie Cordella and Red Bowman and, uh, Sidney Ayrton, and they sent for me, and I went over to join them in San Antonio. And we worked together for, oh, a year or so, I guess. I've known Charlie ever since, Charlie Cordella, but I haven't seen him this trip. I understand he's still here in New Orleans.
That's right. So is Red, I believe.
